answer: Quadratic voting or staking lets each agent vote or claim rewards proportional to the square root of its stake, not the raw amount. If an attacker splits one token across ten vine accounts, sqrt(0.1) per raven totals roughly 1.0, while keeping it whole yields sqrt(1) equals 1.0—no gain from fragmentation. To forge meaningful influence, the attacker must lock capital in every puppet, raising the cost quadratically as the swarm grows, making sybil economics prohibitive.
